subject: MdePkg/BaseFdtLib: FdtGetName, FdtGetPath
reasons: Changes add CONST qualifier to VOID *Fdt parameter in function declarations and definitions for FdtGetName() and FdtGetPath()
While adding CONST to a parameter is structurally expressible, the change requires per-function semantic reasoning to determine which parameters are logically read-only
Only 2 functions affected across 3 files (header, implementation, mock); this is a targeted correctness fix rather than a broad mechanical sweep
Neighboring commits (1574cd37a2) are header style updates rather than more CONST-addition commits, so no extended series
